summary: Exec discovery with Sarah Chen (VP Engineering) and Mike Taylor (Platform Lead). Two converging drivers: the EU banking licence (Q3 2025) raises observability expectations, and Datadog spend is approaching $4M/year. Three-tool fragmentation - Splunk SIEM, Datadog APM, Grafana on Prometheus - with three on-call rotations. Decision criteria: single platform for logs/metrics/traces plus SIEM, native Kubernetes ingestion, predictable storage at 7-year audit retention. Datadog renews November 1; need 6-month migration window. POC requirement: 80k EPS at peak. Champion is Mike Taylor; economic buyer is the CTO via Sarah.
